0ddbde7a-3f70-4dfc-8788-f27ab175e2d8.reason: New story under feature #210 so citizens can download a PDF receipt after paying the renewal fee. It traces to FD-012 and is planned for Sprint 5 at 2 points.
0ddbde7a-3f70-4dfc-8788-f27ab175e2d8.title: Create 1 work item in Permit Renewal

fields.label: Title
fields.value: Download a PDF receipt after payment

fields.label: Description
fields.value: As a citizen renewing my permit, I want to download a PDF receipt after I pay the renewal fee, so that I have a record of my payment that I can save or print.
fields.html: As a citizen renewing my permit, I want to download a PDF receipt after I pay the renewal fee, so that I have a record of my payment that I can save or print.

fields.label: Acceptance Criteria
fields.value:
**Scenario 1: Download right after paying**
- **Given** I have just paid my renewal fee by card successfully
- **When** I select "Download receipt (PDF)" on the payment confirmation page
- **Then** a PDF receipt downloads to my device

**Scenario 2: Receipt contents**
- **Given** I have downloaded my PDF receipt
- **When** I open it
- **Then** it shows my name, permit number, payment date and time, payment reference, the last four digits of the card, and the renewal fee amount
- **And** the fee appears only once (FD-012: the fee is charged once, at submission)

**Scenario 3: No receipt without a successful payment**
- **Given** my card payment failed or was cancelled
- **When** I view the payment result page
- **Then** no "Download receipt" option is shown

**Scenario 4: Download again later**
- **Given** I paid for my renewal in an earlier session
- **When** I sign in and open that renewal
- **Then** I can download the same PDF receipt again
fields.html:
Scenario 1: Download right after paying

  • Given I have just paid my renewal fee by card successfully
  • When I select "Download receipt (PDF)" on the payment confirmation page
  • Then a PDF receipt downloads to my device

Scenario 2: Receipt contents

  • Given I have downloaded my PDF receipt
  • When I open it
  • Then it shows my name, permit number, payment date and time, payment reference, the last four digits of the card, and the renewal fee amount
  • And the fee appears only once (FD-012: the fee is charged once, at submission)

Scenario 3: No receipt without a successful payment

  • Given my card payment failed or was cancelled
  • When I view the payment result page
  • Then no "Download receipt" option is shown

Scenario 4: Download again later

  • Given I paid for my renewal in an earlier session
  • When I sign in and open that renewal
  • Then I can download the same PDF receipt again
